update.done.title: {host} is on {version}
update.done.freed: Health check passed. The backup was deleted to free {size}.
update.done.deleted: Health check passed. The backup was deleted.
update.done.kept: Health check passed. The backup is kept for 7 days.
update.failed.sub_restored: Nothing was lost. Your server is back exactly as it was before the update.
update.failed.title: Update didn’t finish
update.failed.sub: Nothing was changed. Your server is still on {version}.
update.failed.sub_restore_failed: The update failed and the backup could not be restored. Members see the maintenance page until it is.
update.advice.kept: The backup is kept until an update succeeds. {reason}
update.advice.generic: Check the log, then try again.
update.advice.disk: Free space on the database disk, then try again.
update.advice.migrate: Check the log for the database change that failed, then try again.
update.advice.health: The new version did not pass its health check. Check the log, then try again.
update.advice.download: The download could not be verified. Try again; if it fails again, check the release.
update.advice.swap: The server could not replace its own program file. Check the log, then try again.
update.advice.backup: The backup could not be made, so nothing was changed. Check the log, then try again.
update.advice.interrupted: The server stopped while the update was running. Try again once it runs normally.
update.advice.restore_failed: Restore backup {id} from Backup & import, or run “mangaveyra backup restore {id}” on the server.
update.container.title: Update to {version} on the host
update.container.sub: The backup is saved. This server runs in a container, so run these commands where you started MangaVeyra.
update.container.after: When {version} starts, this page finishes the update and deletes the backup unless you keep it.
update.container.kept: Backup kept until the new version starts
update.settings.title: Updates · {host} is on {version}
update.settings.sub_off: Update checks are off: this server contacts no release address until you turn them on.
update.settings.sub_never: Not checked yet. Press Check now, or wait for the daily check.
update.settings.no_key: This build has no trusted release key, so it refuses every update and never contacts a release address. Builds from source update as described in the install guide.
update.settings.container: This server runs in a container. An update takes the backup here; then you run the update commands on the host.
update.settings.checks_hint: Once a day and when you press Check now. Only the release address below is contacted, and only signed releases are offered.
update.settings.url_hint: The signed release feed. The server reads stable.json or beta.json and its .sig file from this address.
update.settings.auto_hint: Patch releases only. Each one is backed up first and rolled back if anything fails.
update.settings.need_url: Add the release address to turn checks on.
update.settings.bad_url: The release address must be an http(s) URL without a query or a password.
update.check.current: Up to date: {version} is the newest release
update.check.off: Turn on Check for updates and add the release address first.
update.check.error.no_key: This build has no trusted release key.
update.check.error.fetch: The release address could not be reached.
update.check.error.signature: The release signature did not verify, so nothing was offered.
update.check.error.channel: The release address serves another channel.
update.check.error.version: This build’s version is not a release version.
update.problem.busy: Another update, backup or restore is running. Try again when it finishes.
update.problem.no_backups: Backups are not available on this server yet, so updates can’t run safely.
update.problem.no_download: This release has no download for this server’s platform.
update.problem.stale: The release changed since the last check. Check again.
update.problem.no_key: This build has no trusted release key, so it refuses every update.
update.problem.checks_off: Turn on Check for updates first.
update.problem.signature: The release could not be verified, so nothing was changed.
update.problem.fetch: The release address could not be reached. Nothing was changed.
